guard_policy: evaluate_original_three_prompts_every_four_steps_in_both_arms; shrink uses original threshold0.2 and scale0.7; observe records failures without shrinking
limitations: Four seed-2 development pairs support diagnosis, not population inference or a convergence proof.
Observe-only removes guard enforcement as an experimental factor; no safety or capability-preservation claim follows.
Three optimizer-visible prompts are a weak agreement check, not a held-out capability benchmark.
Both arms still evaluate the guard; the intervention is the shrink policy, not different monitoring effort.
Rate is crossed with guard so its effect is not attributed to the guard alone.
No test evaluation or retrospective redefinition of earlier study success is allowed.
Alternative optimizers, restarts and equal-rank basis alternatives remain subsequent work.
